text:
maria.k: Quick sync — field asked for a tight battlecard we can ship to SDRs next week. Scope: vs cloud AI platforms + LLM APIs + infra vendors. Need: 1-pager claims, 3 supporting evidence bullets, 2 rebut lines, and one short demo hook. Who can own?
raj.p: I can take lead on claims and rebut lines. Will need perf numbers + SLA language from infra.
oliver_d: I can do the demo hook and a tiny story that highlights private vs hosted routing.
jen_product: Heads-up: product wants accuracy caveat for quantized models — include a notch for quality monitoring and rollback.
sam_marketing: Can we aim for a single-slide benchmark snapshot (latency/cost) + one-liner differentiators? SDRs want something scannable.
lia_ops: benchbot just finished a run, uploaded to /shared/bench/173300 — benchbot, can you post a short summary?
benchbot: perf report uploaded: median p95 latency 120ms (hosted), dedicated 70ms, fallback variant avg +30% latency. Cost/unit: dedicated ~0.6x hosted when steady. CSV + charts in folder.
maria.k: Perfect, Raj — use benchbot numbers for one evidence bullet. Prioritize: reliability, predictable unit economics, rollout controls, private deployment options.
raj.p: Draft claims — share for quick edit:``` 
- Production-first latency & reliability: p95 SLAs + failover routes keep apps live.
- Predictable economics: reserved/dedicated pricing + batching reduces per-token cost vs pure per-request APIs.
- Unified runtime: same API + observability across hosted/dedicated/private reduces engineering ops work.
```
oliver_d: Rebut lines idea: "If they say 'we use cloud X endpoints' -> 'Those endpoints lock you into region/patch timing; we offer private control plane + rollback policies.'"
jen_product: Short quality caveat line: "Quantized variants can slightly shift output distributions — Redwood Optimize ties regressions to prompt sets and auto-rolls back."
sam_marketing: For SDR one-liner I suggest: "Redwood: predictable inference — lower unit cost, built-in fallbacks, and enterprise-grade privacy."
maria.k: Nice. Can someone craft the 3 evidence bullets (bench, SLA example, customer quote)? Raj on bench, Lia on SLA wording, Oliver on customer quote draft.
lia_ops: SLA example: "SLA: 99.9% uptime with multi-region fallback; can set per-route latency targets and automatic fallbacks to compatible model variants."
oliver_d: Draft customer quote (anonymized): "Switched to Redwood and cut inference spend 35% while maintaining response SLAs during peak events." Short and punchy.
raj.p: I'm assembling the 1-pager now. Will drop a Google Doc link in 30m for rapid edits. Sam — can you prep SDR phrasing once I post?
sam_marketing: Yep — I'll add 3 TL;DR soundbites and two objection handlers (price and lock-in).
maria.k: Timeline: doc review by EOD today, finalized for design handoff tomorrow morning, SDR deck Monday. If anyone can't make timeline ping me.
jen_product: I'll review the quality monitoring snippet.
lia_ops: I'll sanity-check the SLA phrasing against contracts.
benchbot: reminder: perf csv includes per-model breakdown + token-cost calc. use column 'unit_cost_est'.
raj.p: Link: https://docs.google.com/rdoc/d/1xEXAMPLE — tag me in comments.
maria.k: Thanks team — small, focused, ship fast. :rocket:
